services.name: Exhibit Space
services.desc: The LBJ Museum features unique exhibits of presidential memorabilia, early photographs, local news clippings, a book collection, original copies of the Pedagog college yearbook from the 1920s, campaign and presidential memorabilia, paintings and renderings, miniature statues of LBJ by artists Larry Ludtke and Jimilu Mason, a Great Society speech and comic book, a sample voting machine (ca. 1930), a collection of pens used to sign some of the most important legislation of our times (for example, the Higher Education Act of 1965), and various artifacts. blurb: Lyndon Baines Johnson The Museum of San Marcos commemorates the formative role LBJ’s years as a college student and school teacher played in the landmark Great Society legislation he passed as the 36th president of the United States between Nov. 1963 and Jan. 1969.
